summary: Pretty/Groovy is a 1958 album by jazz trumpeter Chet Baker, released on the World Pacific label. It compiles tracks from the 1953 10 inch LP "Chet Baker Quartet featuring Russ Freeman" together with previously unissued recordings. The material was recorded in 1953 and 1954, with one track dating from 1957.
one_line: Pretty/Groovy is a 1958 World Pacific compilation by jazz trumpeter Chet Baker mixing 1953 quartet tracks with unissued recordings.
key_facts: Pretty/Groovy is an album by jazz trumpeter Chet Baker.
The album was recorded in 1953 and 1954.
One track on the album was recorded in 1957.
The album was released on the World Pacific label in 1958.
The album compiles tracks previously released on the 1953 10 inch LP "Chet Baker Quartet featuring Russ Freeman".
The album also includes previously unissued recordings.
The 1953 10 inch LP is titled "Chet Baker Quartet featuring Russ Freeman".
Chet Baker is the jazz trumpeter credited on Pretty/Groovy.
Russ Freeman is featured on the 1953 10 inch LP whose tracks were compiled on Pretty/Groovy.
